name: Polaris Australis
description: A star 4.3 solar radii and 2.26 solar masses, about 90 parsecs away, measured by Gaia.

paper.credit: Creevey et al. (2023), A&A 674, A26 (Gaia DR3 FLAME)

text.card: A star about 90 parsecs away, 4.3 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.3 solar radii and 2.26 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,192 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Sigma Octantis
quotes.card: Sigma Octantis is a solitary star in the Octans constellation that forms the pole star of the Southern Hemisphere.
quotes.introduction: Its name is also written as σ Octantis, abbreviated as Sigma Oct or σ Oct, and it is officially named Polaris Australis.
